amendments.trigger: The first operator attempt produced the requested structured answer but the CLI terminated at 0.622778 USD under a 0.50 USD ceiling.
amendments.change: Raise the per-case hard ceiling to 1.00 USD so completed structured output can reach the terminal result.

included: two fresh-session repetitions per arm and case
one exact-call trace contract with source corroboration
exact released code-search and code-graph components

hypotheses.statement: The composed arm will match the best single arm on evidence recall across both repetitions.
The composed arm will route every query to its adjudicated modality in both repetitions.
Exact callers and callees questions will use one directed trace without a redundant graph search.
The composed arm will reject the false authentication-bypass candidate with direct counterevidence.

falsifier: Do not claim the Wave 4.1 lift if any activation-bar condition fails. Diagnose only the observed failure mass; do not broaden the product scope.
interpretation_limit: Two repetitions across eight committed fixture cases improve stability evidence but do not establish a comparative accuracy grade or statistical superiority.
